understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by placing every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with a '+' and ensuring that all goal tiles are occupied simultaneously to trigger a WIN and advance through all levels.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn consumed one step from a finite per-level budget. Movement could be done via directional MOVE actions, and pieces could also be repositioned/selected using CLICK actions targeting specific grid coordinates; a CLICK would move the currently selected piece to the clicked tile only if the destination/path was valid (otherwise it would be blocked and the piece would not move). Walls/obstacles prevented movement or placement onto blocked tiles, and when multiple selectable pieces existed, selection/switching was performed by clicking on the other piece’s position to then move it toward goal tiles.
